image_description: A wide-angle interior shot of a church sanctuary looking down the central aisle. The focal point is a raised altar at the far end, positioned beneath a large arched stained-glass window. The altar appears to be a stone or marble structure with a frontal decorative panel (possibly blue mosaic or tile) and is flanked by large floral arrangements. A statue stands on a pedestal behind the altar. Wooden pews line both sides of the aisle in the foreground.
